subject: Workplace Skills
title: Creating a Learning Culture
description: One-minute skill: Creating a Learning Culture.

hook.text: Pixar holds regular 'brain trust' sessions where anyone can critique a director's work. The result: decades of hit films.

buildup.text: In learning cultures, failure is data, feedback is a gift, and curiosity is rewarded. In fear cultures, silence wins.

discovery.text: Leaders set the tone. Share what you learned from a recent mistake. When the leader models learning, the team follows.

twist.text: Learning cultures outperform static ones because they adapt faster. In volatile markets, adaptability trumps execution.

climax.text: Start a weekly 'what I learned' share in your team. Make learning visible and celebrated, not hidden.

punchline.text: Model learning visibly. The culture copies the leader.

quiz.question: How do leaders create a learning culture in their teams?
options: Mandate a certain number of training hours per quarter
Model learning by sharing their own mistakes and lessons openly
Send the team to conferences and workshops
